text:
maria-devex: Quick flag — onboarding a new minimal sample app (next-lite-agent) and found inconsistent auth/retry behavior between the JS SDK and Python SDK. Repro steps below, can someone take a look?

kevin-frontend: Ugh, instant headache. What is inconsistent exactly?

maria-devex: JS SDK stops retrying after a 401 from our auth proxy, even though the backend eventually accepts the token on the next attempt. Python will transparently refresh+retry.

zach-ml: Can you paste the fetch/SDK call? maybe we mapped a 4xx->fatal too early.

maria-devex: Here is the minimal client code from the sample: 
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY, retry: { retries: 2 } });
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood/small-chat', input: 'hi' });
```
Logs show: first request -> 401 from auth-proxy, SDK surfaces auth error immediately, no retry. Meanwhile logs on service side show token validated 1s later and request succeeded.

ani-eng: Do we bubble some error type that disables retries? I remember we classify 401 as non-retriable by default.

maria-devex: Yes, seems JS SDK treats 401 as terminal. Python SDK has special-case refresh flow that tries once more. The sample app expects the SDK to hide transient auth races for dev onboarding.

kevin-frontend: Repro in CI? or local flaky only?

maria-devex: Repro locally with ephemeral credentials (edge case: fast token issuance). Also our CI flaky test `examples/next-lite-agent` failed in last run.

ci-bot: [ci] build 4821 failed: examples/next-lite-agent smoke test — exit code 1. See https://ci.internal/4821

sophie-onboard: We want samples to "just work" for new users. If the JS SDK is stricter, onboarding will hit this and file bug reports. Can we change SDK to try 1 retry on 401 when retry.retries > 0?

zach-ml: That sounds reasonable for dev ergonomics but we should gate it behind a flag or only for client-side token flows. We don't want infinite retries for legit auth failures.

ani-eng: Proposal: treat 401 as retriable if the response includes header `x-rw-auth-retry: 1` or if client opts in via `retry.authRetry: true`. Default stays current. This preserves safety but lets samples opt in.

maria-devex: For the sample, set `retry: { retries: 2, authRetry: true }` and add a one-line comment explaining why. Also add a QA note.

kevin-frontend: Can you open a tiny PR to the JS SDK and one to the sample? I can review.

maria-devex: Will open PRs: SDK INF-4321 (auth-retry opt-in) and sample INF-4322 (docs + config). I'll add a changelog blurb.

zach-ml: Also add an integration test that simulates auth-proxy 401 then 200 on retry. CI should catch regressions.

maria-devex: Good call. I'll add a flaky-tolerant test harness that toggles `x-rw-auth-retry`.

sophie-onboard: Small UX doc update request: add a note in the sample README under "Auth" describing ephemeral credential race and the temporary workaround. New users keep hitting that paragraph.

ani-eng: Ack. I can help land the SDK change in a patch release if we want to minimize churn.

kevin-frontend: If we're changing public behavior, let's feature-flag it behind `authRetry` in the first patch and make it default in next minor after usage telemetry.

maria-devex: Sounds like plan. I'll file the two PRs tonight and ping reviews. Thanks all :pray: 

ci-bot: [ci] created job 4822: examples/next-lite-agent smoke test (queued)

kevin-frontend: Thanks — ping me when PR is up, I'll do a quick pass. :thumbsup:
